gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters from strokes that all end at one measured thickness, with a skyward x-height line. Noto Sans Brahmi, by contrast, is a low-contrast sans.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Thin, bent-tubing letters with a c as open as a paperclip lead the way in Megrim. And Noto Sans Buginese follows with short ascenders and mouths left open like unjoined chalk arcs.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Futuristic and angular, Megrim bends its letters like tubing, while Noto Sans Buhid keeps generous gaps between curve ends and stems. Make the heading small and the tubing feel thins out fast.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-carian: Megrim outlines every counter in one steady thickness. Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades, so extended text reads clean and unhurried beneath that wiry heading.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Noto Sans Chakma packs its lowercase up toward the caps, with uncrowded mouths on the s and c. But Megrim above it is a thread of ink with no swelling, and that stark difference is the pair's hook.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-cham: Futuristic and angular, Megrim looks marker-drawn in every character. Noto Sans Cham answers with tall rounded lowercase forms and generous entry space in its c, which gives the pair its strongest quality: plain wiriness against soft fullness.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee sets a tall band of letters under short stalks, with an e that gapes at its terminal. Megrim does angular, hairline-free display work best; the body font does approachable, steady text.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Wiry, angular, a little sci-fi: Megrim gives every stroke the same gauge. And Noto Sans Chorasmian handles the text work, with curves that stop short and a large x-height under short ascenders.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Thin and angular, with a futuristic edge, Megrim keeps every stroke at the same gauge. And Noto Sans Coptic grounds it with a dense middle zone and uncrowded s and c mouths.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Clean and futuristic, Megrim keeps its round bowls in an outline that never swells or thins. Noto Sans Cuneiform meanwhile opens its e and puffs its lowercase like inflated glass beads, so display gets precision and text gets plumpness.
